boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UAlbany spaces for studying, walking, art, performances, and low-key recreation, each supported by a current University source.

cards.title: Walk the Purple Path
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus perimeter
cards.notes: Use this multi-modal campus loop for a walk, run, or bike ride; choose a section that fits the time you have between classes.
cards.short_summary: A named perimeter route for walking, running, and biking.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany identifies the Purple Path as a multi-modal path around the exterior of campus used by campus and community members.
cards.access_notes: Use campus paths responsibly and follow posted conditions.

cards.title: Pause in the Azalea Garden
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Bring a book or laptop during spring and summer, when the garden’s seasonal blooms make it an easy outdoor pause between tasks.
cards.short_summary: A campus garden documented as a place to enjoy spring and summer blooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany highlights the Azalea Garden and its spring and summer blooms; its official page includes an image of a student working there.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions vary by season and weather.

cards.title: Check the Performing Arts Center calendar
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Look for a play or concert and plan around the event listing; this is a campus venue for performances throughout the year.
cards.short_summary: A campus performance venue for plays and concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany states that the Performing Arts Center presents plays and concerts year-round.
cards.access_notes: Attendance and ticketing depend on the individual performance.

cards.title: Visit the University Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts building, Academic Podium
cards.notes: Check the exhibition schedule before heading over, then use the galleries or Collections Study Space as a focused art-viewing stop.
cards.short_summary: A Fine Arts building museum with exhibitions and a collections study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Art Museum is located in the Fine Arts building on the Academic Podium and presents student and professional work.
cards.source_title: Visit the Museum | University at Albany
cards.access_notes: The museum notes seasonal closures; confirm exhibitions and public hours before visiting.

cards.title: Meet by the Main Fountain
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Use the seating around this named fountain for a daylight meet-up or a short outdoor reset before heading back across campus.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor fountain with adjacent seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany highlights the Main Fountain as a place to sit and enjoy the sun.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor seating and fountain operation are weather-dependent.

cards.title: Take the Entry Plaza route
cards.subtitle: Uptown Campus entry plaza
cards.notes: Build this fountain into a walk across campus and take a brief pause at the plaza rather than treating it only as a pass-through.
cards.short_summary: A named fountain in UAlbany’s entry plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany identifies the Entry Plaza Fountain as a campus feature for a walk through the plaza.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to weather and campus conditions.

cards.title: Play a round at the Great Dane Game Den
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, first floor
cards.notes: Head to the first floor near the Transfer/Commuter Lounge for pool, air hockey, ping pong, or the designated gaming areas.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center recreation room with tabletop and arcade-style activities.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany says the Great Dane Game Den has pool tables, air hockey, ping pong, and gaming areas.
cards.source_title: Campus Center Connections | University at Albany
cards.access_notes: Located on Campus Center’s first floor near the Transfer/Commuter Lounge; check Campus Center conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Set up at University Library
cards.subtitle: West side of the Academic Podium
cards.notes: Choose between group tables, individual seating, or study carrels, then use the library’s floor maps to find a space that fits your task.
cards.short_summary: UAlbany’s largest library offers group and individual study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: University Library provides computer stations and large areas for group study, individual study, and study carrels.
cards.source_title: University Library | University Libraries - University at Albany
cards.access_notes: Located on the west side of the Academic Podium; check library hours and space availability before visiting.

cards.title: Work quietly at Science Library
cards.subtitle: South end of the Academic Podium, behind Campus Center
cards.notes: Use this library when you need individual or group study space, then consult its floor maps to locate a suitable level before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study library behind the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany describes Science Library as a quiet, comfortable place for both individual and group study.
cards.source_title: Visit Us: Locations, Directions and Maps | University Libraries - University at Albany
cards.access_notes: Science Library is on the south end of the Academic Podium behind the Campus Center; confirm current library hours.

cards.title: Study outside in West Garden
cards.subtitle: Between Social Science and University Library
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or reading for a sunny outdoor study break, and use the garden as a simple destination between the library and Social Science.
cards.short_summary: A sunny garden between Social Science and University Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UAlbany describes West Garden as a green, sunny spot for studying, located between Social Science and University Library.
